T1.texte: a sunday without short videos, hour by hour

en: your cortisol is at it's peak in the morning, and how
you begin your day sets the mood for the rest of it
T2.fr: ton cortisol est [[au max le matin]], et comment tu démarres ta journée [[conditionne tout le reste]]
T2.texte: i woke up and my hand went straight for my phone. habit. i left it [[on airplane mode]] in the kitchen

T3.fr: le sport t'apprend [[à attendre ta récompense]], à l'époque des [[vidéos de 10 secondes]]
T3.texte: i stretched by the window for 10 minutes. weirdly, the morning already felt [[twice as long]]

en: discipline gets easier when discomfort becomes part
T4.fr: la discipline vient toute seule quand [[l'inconfort]] devient [[la routine]]
T4.texte: the first hour was the hardest, [[my thumb kept looking for a screen]]

en: leave the house every single day
T1.fr: sors de chez toi [[tous les jours]]

T2.fr: 24 h entre quatre murs et tu finis par végéter
T2.texte: i walked to the market with no headphones

T3.fr: sors [[au moins 20 à 30 minutes]], idéalement en plein jour
T3.texte: i noticed [[shops i'd walked past for two years]] and never seen

T4.fr: marcher, prendre le soleil, juste changer de décor, ça te recharge plus qu'une heure de plus à « te reposer » au lit
T4.texte: around minute 20 the urge to check something faded and my head got [[quiet enough to actually think]]

en: maybe the next tiktok will finally
T2.fr: le [[prochain tiktok]] va [[enfin]] régler tes problèmes, qui sait
T2.texte: after lunch i grabbed my phone out of [[pure reflex]]

en: your brain a chance to get
T3.fr: limite pas ton temps d'écran, commence surtout pas à [[lire]], laisse jamais ton cerveau [[s'ennuyer]]
T3.texte: [[i put it down after two minutes]] and actually napped, instead of losing the afternoon

en: until it knows what you want
T4.fr: continue de [[nourrir l'algo]] jusqu'à ce qu'il sache ce que tu veux [[mieux que toi]]
T4.texte: i'd opened instagram for messages, and with no reels, [[nothing pulled me in]]

T5.texte: you can remove reels with [[the UnSwipe app]]

en: you can't shortcut being bad at piano, guitar,
T2.fr: piano, guitare, batterie : au début t'es nulle, [[y'a pas de raccourci]]
T2.texte: i finally took out the guitar i'd [[ignored for over a year]]

T3.fr: tu progresses en [[répétant les bases ennuyeuses]] jusqu'à ce que ça devienne automatique
T3.texte: my fingers hurt and i only remembered [[two chords]], but i played them for an hour

en: it teaches patience, consistency, and delayed
gratification better than most productivity advice
T4.fr: ça t'apprend [[la patience, la régularité et à savoir attendre]] mieux que n'importe quel conseil productivité
T4.texte: no idea where the time went. first time all week [[i wasn't checking anything]] for a full hour

en: write in a journal every day
your thoughts feel messy and unclear until you try to
T2.fr: dans ta tête tout est flou, jusqu'à ce que tu essaies de [[l'écrire]]
T2.texte: normally i'd scroll in bed until 1am. tonight i wrote down [[my day]] instead

T3.fr: écrire t'oblige à ralentir et à [[vraiment comprendre ce que tu penses]]
T3.texte: honestly, [[it was a pretty good day]], and i hadn't filmed any of it

T4.fr: 5 minutes avant de dormir suffisent, c'est [[prouvé]], pour commencer à [[penser plus clair]]
T4.texte: i was asleep before 11, and [[my head felt lighter]] than it had in weeks
